proxy_rule.note: rule is measurable and reproducible, but it is still a proxy

expected_from_data_audit.scene_photos_total: about 10 (a few property-loss/food photos); the rest are documents

reasons: rendered share is nearly equal across classes (ai 0.30 vs real 0.30; gap +0.00), so the proxy does not reproduce the documented 'AI mostly rendered / real mostly photographed' bias
the content proxy labels 75/119 (63%) as scene photos, contradicting the documented audit (about 10 (a few property-loss/food photos); the rest are documents)
consequence: data/meta.csv keeps generator/acquisition/content as 'unavailable'; D2/D3 stratification in scripts/split_dataset.py therefore degrades to label-only with its built-in warning. Compliance audit records D2/D3 as PARTIAL: labels are not provided by the brief and the in-project proxy was validated and rejected rather than shipped.
how_to_close: hand-label acquisition/content for the 119 samples (or obtain the brief's metadata) and re-run scripts/split_dataset.py --meta data/meta.csv; the 18-generator cross-generator evidence in reports/cross_generator.json independently covers D2's generalisation intent.
